mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the last three months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS MoM > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO MoM < -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% over the last three months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS MoM > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a broad-based strengthening of demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS MoM > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing by more than 2% year-over-year, the combined effect signals a high inflation environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.
